title: "Research Concept Map"
description: "An interactive, hierarchical view of my quantitative methods research program."
format:
  html:
    toc: false
page-layout: full
---

Click on any of the overarching domains (the larger colored circles) to zoom in and explore the specific methodological and theoretical topics within that area. Click the background to zoom back out.

```{=html}
<div id="circle-packing-container" style="display: flex; justify-content: center; width: 100%; margin-top: 20px;"></div>

<script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js"></script>
<script>
  // 1. Define the hierarchical data based on your research portfolio
  const data = {
    name: "Quantitative Methods",
    children: [
      {
        name: "Causal ML & HTE",
        children: [
          {name: "Causal Inference", value: 1},
          {name: "Causal Machine Learning", value: 1},
          {name: "Nonparametric Regression Trees", value: 1},
          {name: "Debiased/Double Machine Learning", value: 1},
          {name: "Heterogeneous Treatment Effects", value: 1}
        ]
      },
      {
        name: "Multilevel & Bayesian Methods",
        children: [
          {name: "Multilevel Modeling", value: 1},
          {name: "Non-Normal Random Effects", value: 1},
          {name: "Location-Scale Models", value: 1},
          {name: "Adaptive Shrinkage", value: 1},
          {name: "Triple-Goal Estimation", value: 1}
        ]
      },
      {
        name: "Measurement & Policy",
        children: [
          {name: "Measurement & Psychometrics", value: 1},
          {name: "Classification and Ranking", value: 1},
          {name: "Cost-Effectiveness & CBA", value: 1}
        ]
      },
      {
        name: "Computational Foundations",
        children: [
          {name: "Monte Carlo Simulation", value: 1}
        ]
      }
    ]
  };

  // 2. Set up the SVG dimensions and formatting
  const width = 800;
  const height = 800;
  
  // Create a subtle, academic color palette
  const color = d3.scaleLinear()
      .domain([0, 2])
      .range(["#f0f4f8", "#d9e2ec", "#bcccdc"])
      .interpolate(d3.interpolateHcl);

  const pack = data => d3.pack()
      .size([width, height])
      .padding(5)
    (d3.hierarchy(data)
      .sum(d => d.value)
      .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value));

  const root = pack(data);
  let focus = root;
  let view;

  const svg = d3.select("#circle-packing-container").append("svg")
      .attr("viewBox", `-${width / 2} -${height / 2} ${width} ${height}`)
      .style("display", "block")
      .style("margin", "0 -14px")
      .style("background", "white")
      .style("cursor", "pointer")
      .on("click", (event) => zoom(event, root));

  // 3. Draw the circles
  const node = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(root.descendants().slice(1))
    .join("circle")
      .attr("fill", d => d.children ? color(d.depth) : "white")
      .attr("stroke", d => d.children ? null : "#9fb3c8")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
      .attr("pointer-events", d => !d.children ? "none" : null)
      .on("mouseover", function() { d3.select(this).attr("stroke", "#000"); })
      .on("mouseout", function() { d3.select(this).attr("stroke", null); })
      .on("click", (event, d) => focus !== d && (zoom(event, d), event.stopPropagation()));

  // 4. Add the text labels
  const label = svg.append("g")
      .style("font", "14px sans-serif")
      .attr("pointer-events", "none")
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .selectAll("text")
    .data(root.descendants())
    .join("text")
      .style("fill-opacity", d => d.parent === root ? 1 : 0)
      .style("display", d => d.parent === root ? "inline" : "none")
      .text(d => d.data.name);

  // 5. Define the zooming physics
  zoomTo([root.x, root.y, root.r * 2]);

  function zoomTo(v) {
    const k = width / v[2];
    view = v;
    label.attr("transform", d => `translate(${(d.x - v[0]) * k},${(d.y - v[1]) * k})`);
    node.attr("transform", d => `translate(${(d.x - v[0]) * k},${(d.y - v[1]) * k})`);
    node.attr("r", d => d.r * k);
  }

  function zoom(event, d) {
    const focus0 = focus;
    focus = d;
    const transition = svg.transition()
        .duration(750)
        .tween("zoom", d => {
          const i = d3.interpolateZoom(view, [focus.x, focus.y, focus.r * 2]);
          return t => zoomTo(i(t));
        });

    label
      .filter(function(d) { return d.parent === focus || this.style.display === "inline"; })
      .transition(transition)
        .style("fill-opacity", d => d.parent === focus ? 1 : 0)
        .on("start", function(d) { if (d.parent === focus) this.style.display = "inline"; })
        .on("end", function(d) { if (d.parent !== focus) this.style.display = "none"; });
  }
</script>
```
